title: Ordinary vector integration adjunct on one affine linear frame
statement: Fix the finite purity setting P of [def-pur-conventions], its ordinary dualizing objects and source-etale locality of [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data], and the positive Tate presentation Q_T=A_T(d)[2d] of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let S be an affine finite-type k-scheme, F a locally free module of rank d>=0, and pi:V->S its vector-bundle projection [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Let t be any normalized finite-twist pullback transport, D any corresponding normalized ordinary projective-line adjunction family, and N any normalized etale compact-support comparison. Let U be an affine open of S and frame:F|U~O_U^d a linear frame. Put W=pi^{-1}U and j:W->V. Let v:W->A^d_S be the frame isomorphism W~A^d_U followed by A^d_U->A^d_S, in the ordered coordinate-tower presentation, with w:v;p_d=j;pi. Write alpha_pi=c_pi^{-1};adj_pi(int_pi), where int_pi is the actual integration of [def-amb-vector-integration] and c_pi is its canonical base-coefficient Tate pullback. Write alpha_pd for the ordinary ordered affine counit adjunct diagonalAffineMate(t,D,S,d). Then j^*(alpha_pi);locality_N(j,pi) equals c_j;c_v^{-1};v^*(alpha_pd);locality_N(v,p_d);congr(w). This is an equation on one linear frame, contains no orientation e or global descent assertion, and includes empty U and rank zero.

proof.text: Evaluate the defining VectorIntegrationNormalization of vectorBundleIntegration at this affine frame and the given normalized t,D. Its right hand side is the inverse-frame compact-support exchange, the actual coefficient comparison, the inverse compact/tower comparison, and the ordered affine counit. This is the ordinary trace equation before any transpose.

Transpose the trace equation using the fixed exceptional adjunction. Naturality of the Hom bijection changes inverse compact-support exchange into exceptional exchange. Compose with source-etale locality for the frame open and its coordinate map. These localities are the counit-normalized right-adjoint conjugates, so mate pasting cancels the common extension-by-zero counit.

Normalized twist-transport and projective-line datum uniqueness imply the base-change law for the specified t,D. The affine trace base-change equation along U into S identifies the trace on the frame base with the restriction of the ambient trace. The coefficient comparisons agree by induction on d: the zero case is constant-unit pullback composition; at a successor use the tensor-pullback compositor and the normalized shifted Tate-line pullback composition. Move these invertible coefficient maps across the Hom bijection to obtain exactly the displayed equality. Rank zero has the identity ordered adjunction; the empty frame has unique arrows.

theorem vectorIntegration_ordinary_frame_counit (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine S] (aS : S ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aS] [QuasiCompact aS]
    (d : ℕ) (F : S.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      (hT : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t T hT)
    (N : Etale.EtaleCompactSupportNormalization P.Coefficient) :
    letI := isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType aS
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry S d F).1
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry S d F).2.1
    letI := isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F ≫ aS)
    letI : HasCompactification (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F) := inferInstance
    letI := affineTraceNoetherian S d
    ∀ (U : S.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme]
      (frame : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F U),
      let p := VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d F
      let W := p ⁻¹ᵁ U
      letI := isNoetherian_of_locallyOfFiniteType W.ι
      ∀ (v : W.toScheme ⟶ affineTraceTower S d)
        [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [QuasiCompact v]
        (_hv : v = VectorBundleZeroSection.trivializationMap S d F U frame ≫
          AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) U.ι ≫ (affineTraceAffineSpaceIso S d).inv)
        (w : v ≫ affineTraceProjection S d = W.ι ≫ p),
        letI : HasCompactification (W.ι ≫ p) := inferInstance
        letI : HasCompactification (v ≫ affineTraceProjection S d) := by
          rw [w]
          infer_instance
        (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient W.ι).map
            ((Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
              P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t p (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aS) d).inv ≫
            (Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient)
              p).homEquiv _ _
                (Etale.vectorBundleIntegration P.diagonalExponent
                  (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.Coefficient
                  P.diagonalExponent_annihilates S (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aS) d F)) ≫
            (P.diagonalEtaleLocality N W.ι p).hom =
          (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
            P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t W.ι (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit (p ≫ aS)) d).hom ≫
          (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
            P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t v
              (affineTraceInvertible P.diagonalExponent S (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aS) d)
                d).inv ≫
          (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient v).map
            (P.diagonalAffineMate t D S (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aS) d) ≫
          (P.diagonalEtaleLocality N v (affineTraceProjection S d)).hom ≫
          (P.diagonalDualizingCongr w).hom
